question.text: The acidic hydrolysis of ether (X) shown below is fastest when

options.text: One phenyl group is replaced by a methyl group.
One phenyl group is replaced by a para-methoxyphenyl group.
Two phenyl groups are replaced by two para-methoxyphenyl groups.
No structural change is made to X.

solution.text: When two phenyl groups are replaced by two para methoxy group, carbocation formed will be more stable
